promotion_basis: Exact AArch64 instruction and relocation parity across the 96-byte ELF symbol, strict Ghidra C/P-Code comparison, strict Joern, reproducible Docker build, compatible absence of a standalone KCFI preamble, and passing host harness.
limitations: Offline/static evidence only; procfs registration and teardown remain unverified on NX809J hardware/runtime.
The implementation uses an exact Assembly island plus a typed proc_ops ELF alias to preserve the stock callback table and Ghidra rendering.
Sanitizers, register/bus ledger, state/effect ledger, semantic counterexample search and independent runtime review remain deferred.
